description: Responsible for creating brand awareness within the defined market, building relationships with key executives, developing/pursuing leads, and assisting consultants with qualifying and winning opportunities.

Assisted Managing director with recruiting efforts (On-Campusrecruiting from major universities, LinkedIn Recruiter). Responsible for creating strategic and tactical plans to uncover and close a range of revenue projects.

Development and implementation of target account pursuits as well as current account development plans. Training of consultants on tactics and strategies for farming accounts and identifying new business opportunities.
Infiltrating and influencing decision-makers at the highest levels within the account. As the BDM I leverage these relationships to introduce SEI, create and pursue selling opportunities.

matchmaking_summary: The candidate presents a strong background in business development with over twenty years of experience in sales and relationship building. Their expertise includes developing brand awareness, utilizing strategic planning for lead generation and account management. The candidate's interpersonal skills, solid communication abilities, and ability to present value propositions are key strengths highlighted in their career history.
